chart.title: Hospital beds per 1,000 people
chart.subtitle: Hospital beds include inpatient beds available in public, private, general, and specialized hospitals and rehabilitation centers. In most cases beds for both acute and chronic care are included.
chart.citation: World Health Organization (WHO) data, via World Bank (2026)
